interval: UTC hour start. IEM instantaneous routine report nearest hour, at most 30 minutes; NASA solar hourly mean.
observationSelection: Nearest timestamp; ties choose earlier original timestamp, then lexicographic full CSV row. Exactly half-hour reports map to later hour.

solarSource.coordinateNotes: Requested coordinates are not a station. Source-native grids: MERRA-2 meteorology 0.5° latitude × 0.625° longitude; SYN1deg solar 1° × 1°. Returned point geometry is not a grid-cell-center assertion. Source elevation is not measured site elevation.

warnings: IEM METAR archive has limited quality control. Instantaneous routine observations are matched to nearest UTC hour, not hourly mean weather.
